Issue: Manchester rankings sit entirely on a URL that looks retired. Semrush shows 16 keywords worth 5,080 SV on /areas-we-cover-old/manchester/, 9 of them in the top 20 and the best at p11. The intended page /areas-we-cover/manchester/ has zero keywords in Semrush. London and Birmingham are not affected, their current URLs rank normally.
Why it matters: All of your Manchester visibility, including commercial waste collection manchester at p20, is attached to a URL nobody is maintaining or linking to. Any work on the intended page will not connect to it.
What to do: Check where /areas-we-cover/manchester/ redirects to. If it points at the older URL, rename that one as canonical and keep the rankings. If it points elsewhere, the redirect is the bug. Do not redirect old to new without checking, it may create a loop.

Issue: The Simpler Recycling page ranks p14 for simpler recycling at 1,000 SV and KD 22.
Why it matters: It is one position band away from page one on an existing page. Nothing else on the site is this close for this little work.
What to do: Refresh the content and add internal links from related pages. Target p8 to p10.

Issue: The site answers on both www and non www. betterwaste.co.uk/polystyrene-and-recycling/ and www.betterwaste.co.uk/polystyrene-and-recycling both rank as separate pages.
Why it matters: Every page is competing with a copy of itself. Links and ranking signals are split in half across two versions of the site.
What to do: Pick one hostname. Add a site wide redirect, set the canonical tag and set the preferred property in Search Console.

Issue: The London and Birmingham city URLs were recorded as redirecting when Ahrefs last crawled the site on 28 and 29 July 2026, yet both rank normally in Semrush today. /areas-we-cover-old/london/ and /areas-we-cover-old/birmingham/ still return 200 with live page titles.
Why it matters: Nothing is broken in the rankings, so this is not urgent. But two live copies of each city page is the same duplication problem as the www issue, and the crawl data is two months old so the current state is unconfirmed.
What to do: Open both current city URLs and both older ones in a browser. If the older pages still load, redirect them to the current ones.

Issue: Four live pages chase the same commercial terms: /commercial-waste-collection/, /commercial-waste-management/, /business-waste-collections/ and /trade-waste-collections/. On top of that the /areas-we-cover/ hub ranks for national terms like business refuse collection at p5.
Why it matters: business waste collection at 2,400 SV ranks twice, p26 and p34, and neither gets near the top 20. Five pages are sharing the authority that one page needs.
What to do: Make /commercial-waste-collection/ the single commercial page. Redirect or de optimise the other three and remove the national terms from the areas hub.

Issue: Your strongest page is a blog post listing competitors. /top-10-commercial-waste-management-companies-in-the-uk/ ranks p4 to p8 for around 20 head terms and links nowhere useful. It also outranks your own service page for commercial waste management companies, p7 against p90.
Why it matters: It is the best ranking asset on the site, it sends in market visitors to read about competitors, and it passes none of its authority to a page that converts.
What to do: Add prominent internal links from it to /commercial-waste-collection/ and reframe it so the service page wins the commercial terms.

Issue: Pages load on both the slash and non slash URL, and six keywords return two of your own URLs at once. Examples: /about and /about/, business waste birmingham at p19 and p26, waste management companies london at p29 and p32.
Why it matters: Same problem as the www issue but smaller. It dilutes signals on individual pages rather than the whole site.
What to do: Pick one trailing slash convention and redirect the other. Find the duplicate page behind each doubled keyword and consolidate.

Issue: Test and leftover pages are indexable: /222-2/, /test-2/, /home/, /thank-you/, /trial-form/, /quote2-old/ and two other old quote forms. /quote2/ also has six indexable parameter versions.
Why it matters: Low impact on its own, but it is wasted crawl budget and these pages say nothing good about site quality.
What to do: Noindex or delete them and add parameter handling for the quote form.

Issue: Two live pages cover the same service: /clinical-waste-disposal-clinical-waste-collection-companies/ and /healthcare-waste/.
Why it matters: Low priority because the clinical head terms are council dominated and not winnable anyway. Worth tidying when you next touch that area.
What to do: Merge into one page and point it at commercial terms such as dental waste disposal and sharps bin collection.

Issue: Four former pages now return 404: /better-waste-solutions-birmingham/, /better-waste-solutions-london/, /better-waste-solutions-manchester/ and /business-waste-management-yorkshire/.
Why it matters: If anyone links to these the value is being thrown away. If nobody does, there is nothing to fix.
What to do: Check referring domains for each. Redirect only the ones that actually hold links.
